title: 095-16-OFT-001 Rev.2 Technical offer OIL TO SALT HEAT EXCHANGERS - Solana
summary:
- Technical offer for 36 Oil to Salt Heat Exchangers for Solana Thermosolar Power Plant
- Includes design, material procurement, fabrication, inspection, testing at workshop, and transport to site
- Equipment designed for pressure loss as specified for SOLANA Power Plant
- Detailed description of materials, features, and scope of supply
- References to technical specifications and data sheets
- Manhole gasket will be welded type.
- Tube material is carbon steel SA-210-A1.
- Stainless steel sliding plates are used as per Lointek’s standard.
- Insulation is excluded from the scope of supply.
- Field service for erection, start-up or commissioning is optional.
- Battery limits are based on equipment connections.
- Codes include ASME II, V, VIII Div.1, and others.
